evidence_location.quote: Preparation of cellular RNA and subsequent processing for GeneChip analysis were performed as described elsewhere [28], by use of the HG-U133 A 2.0 and HG-U133 Plus 2.0 GeneChips (Affymetrix) and the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer system (Agilent Technologies), to assess the integrity and quantity of RNA.

OBI ontology.obi_label: real time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction assay

evidence_location.quote: To confirm observations from the gene chip data, TaqMan Gene Expression Assays (Applied Biosystems) were used to detect genes in the immunoproteosome pathway (PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and PSMA4) in 3 randomly chosen samples from protected and nonprotected persons, at 2 weeks after the third vaccination. The fluorescence signals were measured in real time with the use of ABI HT7900, and critical threshold values were generated using the software SDS2.1 (Applied Biosystems).
